sentences.text: Meghan Marguerite McCain -LRB- born October 23 , 1984 -RRB- is an American columnist , author , Fox News host and contributor , and blogger .	American	United States	Fox News	Fox News

She is the daughter of 2008 presidential nominee and long-time U.S. Senator John McCain and Cindy Hensley McCain .	U.S. Senator	United States Senate	John McCain	John McCain	2008	United States presidential election, 2008	Cindy Hensley McCain	Cindy Hensley McCain

McCain first received media attention in 2007 for her blog , McCain Blogette , on which she documented life on the campaign trail and mused about fashion , music , and pop culture .	the campaign trail	John McCain presidential campaign, 2008	fashion	fashion	music	music	pop culture	popular culture
In 2009 , she became a contributing author for The Daily Beast , and in 2011 , began appearing as a contributor on MSNBC .	The Daily Beast	The Daily Beast	MSNBC	MSNBC

In 2013 , she began hosting on the start-up Pivot channel and in 2014 assumed the co-host role on Pivot 's TakePart Live until that show was canceled later in the year .	Pivot	Pivot (TV channel)	TakePart Live	TakePart Live
In July 2015 , McCain joined Premiere Networks as host of the nationally syndicated radio program America Now .

McCain also signed on as a FOX News contributor in July 2015 , and was officially named a regular co-host of the afternoon talk program Outnumbered on November 14 , 2016 .	Outnumbered	Outnumbered (TV program)
